lines.text: Say don't you, not isn't it!
Many learners say: You like tea, isn't it?
Better: You like tea, don't you?
The end must match the verb.
Doesn't she! She works here, doesn't she?

data.why: The end must match the verb.

en.tip: Many learners end every sentence with isn't it, but the end must match the verb.
en.caption: Do you say this? “You like tea, isn't it?” 😅 The right way is “You like tea, don't you?” This is right because the end must match the verb. Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
